reason: PairwiseSDPD has writeState/readState, but PairwiseSDPDInteraction inherits no-op MirObject checkpoint/restart. The stress wrapper owns another copied kernel RNG; its state and StressManager scheduling are also unproven.
official_examples: interactions.py exercises DPD at dt=0; particle_vector.py exercises PV-only restart at dt=0. Neither validates nonzero-dt SDPD.

state_contract.particles: PV XMF/HDF5: global positions, velocities, int64 IDs and persistent channels; mass must be reconstructed from the exact frozen specification.
state_contract.coordinator: u.restart restores simulation.state.txt: currentTime, currentStep, checkpointId. PV InitialConditions.Restart alone does not.
state_contract.dt: Not in coordinator state file; exact frozen dt must be checked and passed to run.
state_contract.RNG: Required: both active SDPD kernel generators, lastTime, lastSample, mt19937 state and stress scheduling. NOT PERSISTED by this SDPD interaction.
state_contract.integrator: Current vv uses x and v plus freshly computed force; no hidden half-velocity serialized. Native checkpoint is after cell lists, before force clearing/integration of current_step.
state_contract.channel_phase: Saved fields belong to the preceding force step; recompute ephemeral channels before advancing, do not report stale fields as a new measurement.
state_contract.plugins: Re-register the same names/order. Fresh per-segment output directories and external absolute-step counters; plugin restart support is not assumed.
state_contract.file_links: MirObject createCheckpointSymlink actually uses ln -f (hard links). Materialize every file independently; record aliases and XMF references.
state_contract.save_phase: No public manual checkpoint binding. Scheduled checkpoint at step N is reached by running through step N (N+1 advances from zero). Archive uses state.txt, never the directory label. Any extra advanced step is charged and excluded from the committed checkpoint chain.
